independent_limits: This is an independent model-based review of the 14 core proposals, five optional refinements and four holds, not a new full review of the other 318 priority entries or the 717-entry catalogue.

The author package partition of 341 = 323 bounded retained + 14 proposals + four holds is reported as input, not independently awarded language completion. The five optional refinements are within the retained set.
Accept means acceptable exact wording under the stated source/static scope. It is not native-human, installed UI, layout, font, TalkBack, speech, behavioral or whole-language certification.

For the two source-only accepted proposals, absence of direct references does not prove unused status. Full dynamic composition remains unverified; the unknown palette third argument remains a separate hold.
Core status is not a count of 14 confirmed live defects. Several edits clarify potentially ambiguous but understandable wording, and two have only source-string context.
Primary terminology evidence is corroboration with explicit access/scope limits. No preferred attribution noun was invented from a weak source.

Exact original source/value identities bind the original review. Current complete-source comparisons and runtime gaps are recorded separately; later source stability does not silently renew consumer acceptance.
